typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		CLAIM_ID as string,
		CHARGE_AMOUNT as string,
		PAID_AMOUNT as string,
		PAID_DT as string,
		GRGR_CK as string,
		SOURCE_SYSTEM as string,
		CLAIM_TYPE as string,
		SUBSC_DEPENDENT_INDICATOR as string,
		SUBSC_FIRST_NAME as string,
		SUBSC_LAST_NAME as string,
		MBR_RLTNSHP_CD as string,
		FROM_DATE as string,
		POLICY_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @grgr_ck VARCHAR(10) = ?  SELECT DISTINCT 	 MEMBER_ID 	,SUBSC_DEPENDENT_INDICATOR  	,SUBSC_FIRST_NAME  	,SUBSC_LAST_NAME  	,MBR_RLTNSHP_CD  	,CLCL_ID AS CLAIM_ID 	,CHARGE_AMOUNT 	,PAID_AMOUNT 	,PAID_DT 	,GRGR_CK 	,SOURCE_SYSTEM 	,CLAIM_TYPE             	,CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT AS FROM_DATE 	,MECB_POLICY_ID AS POLICY_ID FROM [dbo].[A2AMonthlyClaimsImport] WHERE GRGR_CK = @grgr_ck ORDER BY MEMBER_ID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> DMQDataMiningAnthemMedicaidClaims
DMQDataMiningAnthemMedicaidClaims derive(MARKET_NAME = $Market) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive(DC_PAID_AMOUNT = toString(PAID_AMOUNT),
		DC_SUBSC_FIRST_NAME = toString(SUBSC_FIRST_NAME),
		DC_SUBSC_DEPENDENT_INDICATOR = toString(SUBSC_DEPENDENT_INDICATOR),
		DC_GRGR_CK = toString(GRGR_CK),
		DC_MBR_RLTNSHP_CD = toString(MBR_RLTNSHP_CD),
		DC_CLAIM_ID = toString(CLAIM_ID),
		DC_SOURCE_SYSTEM = toString(SOURCE_SYSTEM),
		DC_CLAIM_TYPE = toString(CLAIM_TYPE),
		{Copy of FROM_DATE} = toString(FROM_DATE),
		{Copy of POLICY_ID} = toString(POLICY_ID),
		DC_PAID_DT = toString(PAID_DT),
		DC_MEMBER_ID = toString(MEMBER_ID),
		DC_SUBSC_LAST_NAME = toString(SUBSC_LAST_NAME),
		DC_CHARGE_AMOUNT = toString(CHARGE_AMOUNT)) ~> DCNVConvertUnicodetoPlainString
DCNVConvertUnicodetoPlainString sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> EXDSTAnthemMedicaidA2AMonthClaims
